liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Listener praises the layered, patient playing in this specific song transition; Phil led an all-time great performance of this song transition [22][24]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): The first set featured excellent performances of Minglewood and Looks Like Rain [24]
- **New Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Phil played large, impactful bass notes during this specific song [23]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-06.aud.Holtz-Bolton.Nak100s.112860.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 145 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-10-06.167957.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.fixed.167675.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1984-10-06.178333.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min [5]
- **gd1984-10-06.109985.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [9]. Said about its sound: Tapers positioned well to capture high levels and clear instrumental interplay; This source offers the best overall balance with plenty of low-end presence [24][27]
- **gd1984-10-06.beyerm88.suraci.77750.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [10]. Said about its sound: China Doll begins with a cut because it was recorded on the cassette's second side [10]
- **gd1984-10-06.fob.nak100.holtz.jaz.92383.flac16**: source not stated; 17 songs; 147 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [20]. Said about its sound: Recording features crisp highs while retaining significant low-end thump [22]
- **gd1984-10-06.127557.set2.schoeps.oade.BCE.flac1648**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 11 songs; 94 min; rated 4.75/5 by 4 [21]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is a huge improvement over other available sources for this show; A second-generation audience tape from this tour was incredibly crisp [28][30]

## Around the show

- Crowd was quiet and hunkered down initially, then bounced wildly during the second set [26]
- The atmosphere was described as a grey fall day with a small scene [26]
- Heavy police presence was noted at the Richmond venue during this tour [30]
- Listener wishes for an SBD to mix with this strong 1984 second set [27]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-06.aud.Holtz-Bolton.Nak100s.112860.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz and Tony Bolton; transferred by Greg Holtz; source: Tapers: Greg Holtz, Tony Bolton, and Mark Kotyuk. Source: Nakamichi CM100s w/CP-4 Shotgun Capsules > FOB -> D-6 > MAC; [1]. Also: Transfer made in 1998 from master analog tape to Sony D-3 DAT [1]
- **gd1984-10-06.167957.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.fixed.167675.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [2]. Also: Schoeps CMC4 MK41 source supplies patches in the post-China Doll jam and Space [2]
- **gd1984-10-06.178333.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Stephen Thomas; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Stephen Thomas' Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 capsules > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Beyer M160 source supplies crowd noise and patches in China Doll and Goin' Down [5]
- **gd1984-10-06.109985.beyer-senn-daweez.D5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Beyer M-88's & 1 Beyer M-160 Microphones > Nak MX100 w/2001> Sony TC-D5M (Dolby on) - analog master cassettes; [9]
- **gd1984-10-06.beyerm88.suraci.77750.flac16**: taped by Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: FOB/Beyer M88's>Sony D5M(XLIIS) [10]. Also: Tony Suraci recorded using a Nac 550 with high input levels; Eugene D. loaned the microphones and D5 recorder for this taping [10][23]
- **gd1984-10-06.fob.nak100.holtz.jaz.92383.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz; transferred by Greg Holtz and JAZ; source: Nakamichi CM100s CP4caps, FOB-> D-6 [20]
- **gd1984-10-06.127557.set2.schoeps.oade.BCE.flac1648**: taped by Doug Oade; transferred by Dave Usborne; source: flac16/48kHz ; Set 2 Source from Doug Oade: 90 degree, 17cm Schoeps CMC441s at Sbd into an Oade power supply then a modified Sony TCD-D5M then > DAW (via SEKD… [21]. Also: Doug Oade and Jim Wise are identified as the elite tapers [30]
